evidence.note: Swarm of ~60 agent dots joined to the package mirror by dense ~1px light-grey spoke lines that overlap into a fine fan; these hairlines would blur or vanish under compression.
At the small viewer size the spokes and tiny agent dots shrink further, and the folder-icon grid above the mirror is drawn in thin outline strokes that merge into a grey smudge.
'PUBLIC INTERNET' label and globe are very pale grey on near-white, low contrast; at 1288x598 the label is small and faint.
Sub-lines in the three boxes ('cached modified targets', 'tripwire messages') are small mid-grey text, around 13px at this size.
Title, timeline items, quote card and legend use large, high-contrast type; no texture or grain anywhere, paper feel from flat colour.

rationale: The title, timeline and cards use generous type on flat colour, which meets the pass anchors. But the core swarm diagram depends on dense 1px grey spoke hairlines and thin outline icons, and the 'PUBLIC INTERNET' label is faint, small text; compression would erase these. That matches the fail descriptor (hairlines, small faint text).
